description: arrow_clause_empty enumerates 0u32..1u32<<n_pos and panics at 32 positives. Red construct 32 distinct-arity arrows via logical conjunction/difference and ask subtype to one member; must terminate true without panic. Need width-independent exact algorithm with pruning, not larger fixed integer or cap/approximation. Test 32/64+, small exhaustive oracle. One fresh agent, one commit onto PR215.
title: Remove fixed-width arrow subset enumeration limit
